profile.name: LabJack U12 数据采集设备
profile.description: LabJack U12 是一款 USB 数据采集设备，可进行模拟量输入、差分模拟输入、模拟量输出和数字输入/输出，适用于实验中的电压采集、低噪声差分测量、简单信号输出以及开关量控制。
profile.description_en: The LabJack U12 is a USB data acquisition device that supports analog input, differential analog input, analog output, and digital input/output. It is used in laboratories for voltage acquisition, low-noise differential measurements, simple signal output, and digital switching/control.
